verdict.rationale: SerpApi's own documented capability covers only the search step: structured SERP results across many engines, with LLM-optimized markdown output and an official MCP server so agents can call it as a web search tool. Nothing in the evidence shows it fetching or extracting the contents of result pages, or synthesizing answers. The RAG use-case expects the user to build the rest of the pipeline. missing for 10: page-content extraction endpoint, built-in synthesis/answer generation, a single-API multi-step research workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.
